statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I47.1
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
